preregistration.research_question: 在保持 task-board bootstrap、completion、预算和工具语义不变的前提下，消除首次 list_tasks 到 create_task 的并发可见性 race 后，agent 是否形成更互补的 task decomposition？
preregistration.intervention: enable runtime-only initialization_lease_v1; serialize first board visibility and first create/claim decisions in canonical agent-ID order without assigning scopes
primary_outcomes: initialization visibility: ordered lease acquisition/release and non-empty board observations
decomposition quality: materially distinct subsystem/route/security-objective scopes, ownership, duplicate work
task effectiveness: completed artifacts, evidence_refs and evidence reuse
unchanged_semantics: model, seed, prompt text, tools, scheduler, target, evaluator, retry and wall-clock
